title: UAAP: Clutch Delos Reyes bucket lifts La Salle to upset of NU
summary: De La Salle University completed a stunning 84-83 upset of National University to stay in the Final 4 race in the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament, Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum.
